desc: Read the input values $N$ and the list of coordinates $X$.
Compute the initial gaps between adjacent coordinates.
Separate the gaps into two lists: one for odd-indexed gaps and one for even-indexed gaps.
Sort both lists of gaps in ascending order.
Reconstruct the sequence of gaps by placing the sorted odd gaps into odd positions and sorted even gaps into even positions.
Calculate the minimum sum of coordinates using the formula involving $X_1$ and the weighted sum of the new gaps.
